title: The Greatest Salesman In The World

questions.q: What does Mandino mean by "love everything and everyone"?
a: Approach all with kindness and understanding
Feel romantic attraction to each person
questions.why: Mandino's advice is about unconditional kindness, not romance.

questions.q: How many times does Mandino repeat "I will act now" in the later scrolls?
questions.why: The text notes the phrase appears 18 times.

questions.q: What does Mandino suggest when persistence becomes exhausting?
questions.why: He emphasizes breaks as part of persistent action.

questions.q: According to the book, what two components are essential for success?
questions.why: The text lists self‑awareness and emotional control as key.

questions.q: What happens when a salesman lets anger affect a client?
a: The sale is lost and relationships fail
The client buys more out of guilt
questions.why: Anger leads to lost sales and broken relationships.
